map.由应力强度因子求断裂韧度 使用指南: Fracture toughness from stress intensity factor user guide
map.输入几何因子Y、工作应力σ与裂纹半长a，按 K_IC = Y·σ·√(πa) 计: Enter the geometry factor Y, working stress σ and crack half-length a; computes the stress intensity factor as K_IC = Y·σ·√(πa) to assess the fracture safety of cracked components.
map.K = Y·σ·√(πa)；K≥K_IC 时失稳。 示例 → 约 19.9 MP: K = Y·σ·√(πa); instability occurs when K ≥ K_IC. Example -> about 19.9 MPa√m.
map.输入几何因子 Y、应力 σ、裂纹半长 a，求应力强度因子。: Enter the geometry factor Y, stress σ and crack half-length a to get the stress intensity factor.
map.：K_IC 为平面应变断裂韧性（MPa·m^0.5）。临界 K=Y*sigma*: : K_IC is the plane-strain fracture toughness (MPa·m^0.5). The critical K = Y*sigma*sqrt(pi*a); when K reaches K_IC, unstable propagation occurs. Steel K_IC is about 50 and aluminium alloy about 25.
map.：已知 K_IC 与应力，可反推允许最大裂纹 a_c；探伤门槛据此定。: : Given K_IC and stress, the maximum allowable crack size a_c can be back-calculated; the inspection threshold is set accordingly.

map.K_IC 大说明什么？: What does a large K_IC mean?
map.材料即使有裂纹也能承受更高应力才扩展，抗脆断好；高强钢若 K_IC 低则怕缺陷（: The material can carry higher stress before a crack propagates, giving good resistance to brittle fracture; high-strength steel with a low K_IC is sensitive to defects (such as weld cold cracking).
map.为什么厚件更脆？: Why are thick sections more brittle?
map.厚件满足平面应变、K_IC 最低（最保守），薄件平面应力韧性高；故用最厚件的 K: Thick sections satisfy plane strain and give the lowest (most conservative) K_IC, while thin sections in plane stress have higher toughness; therefore the K_IC of the thickest section is used for conservative design.
